documents.title: Synthetic Identity Guide
sections: A password manager stores unique credentials for every account. Password reuse increases risk.
Store a salted password hash. A random salt makes equal passwords produce different hashes.

documents.title: Synthetic Network Guide
sections: A firewall filters incoming network traffic. A deny rule blocks an unwanted connection.
A network switch forwards frames within a local area network.

documents.title: Synthetic Pattern Guide
sections: A regular expression describes a text pattern. Anchors match the start or end of a line.
A parser builds a syntax tree from structured text. A grammar defines valid expressions.
